context:
DECISION GATE w1: pick the authoritative source key and its precedence order, from evidence rather than assumption. Candidates: platform.config.execution_mode (what current develop emits), execution.mode, config.mode. The 105 bundles where config.mode='dataframe' but execution.mode='sql' prove the two disagree, so the precedence must be justified against actual run provenance, not chosen for convenience. Record which key wins and why, and what happens when they conflict (prefer leaving NULL over guessing).

Then fix the extractor, backfill the snapshot, and pin it with a test that fails if any published bundle yields NULL. Audit tuning_mode, compliance_class, and has_plans for the same class of key-path drift before closing.
description:
MEASURED 2026-08-23. execution_mode is NULL for all 207 rows in results-explorer/public/data/results.duckdb, so the SQL-vs-DataFrame facet -- the differentiator BenchBox leads with in the README -- filters nothing on the public site.

Cause: _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py:339-351 (_execution_mode) reads only config.execution_mode and execution.execution_mode. No bundle writes either key.
 - Legacy corpus bundles write config.mode and execution.mode (across 207: 105 have config.mode='dataframe' with execution.mode='sql', 100 have sql/sql, 2 dataframe/dataframe -- so config.mode alone is NOT a safe source).
 - A bundle produced by current develop writes platform.config.execution_mode='sql' (verified on tpcds_sf1_duckdb_sql_20260823_085826_fc9467d8.json). The transformer misses this too, so the facet stays NULL for NEW bundles as well. This is a live bug, not a legacy-data problem.

Same shape, same file, worth checking together: tuning_mode is NULL for all 207 rows, compliance_class is NULL for all 207, and has_plans is false for all 207.

Not to be confused with rewrite-explorer-transformer-to-use-typed-models-throughout, which is a refactor and does not fix this.

anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD leave NULL and let the test fail
anti_patterns.why: it would mislabel every DataFrame result and the facet would be confidently wrong instead of visibly empty

anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD apply the precedence decided in w1
anti_patterns.why: 105 of 207 bundles have config.mode='dataframe' while execution.mode='sql'

anti_patterns.dont: Rewrite the transformer to typed models as part of this fix
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD make the narrow fix and leave the refactor to its own item
anti_patterns.why: that is a separate tracked refactor and it would bury a one-key fix in a large diff

preserves.behavior: A genuinely unknown mode stays NULL rather than being inferred
Bundles remain unmodified: this is a read-side extraction fix, not a corpus rewrite

prior_art.concept: _tuning_mode already documents a multi-location fallback pattern

verifications.command: uv run -- python _project/scripts/explorer_publish.py build --data-dir results-data/ --output results-explorer/public/data/ && uv run -- python -c "import duckdb; c=duckdb.connect(\"results-explorer/public/data/results.duckdb\", read_only=True); rows=c.execute(\"select execution_mode, count(*) from results group by 1 order by 1\").fetchall(); assert rows and all(mode in (\"dataframe\", \"sql\") and count > 0 for mode, count in rows), rows; assert c.execute(\"select count(*) from results where execution_mode is null\").fetchone()[0] == 0"

verifications.expected: no NULL bucket; sql and dataframe both populated

verifications.description: A freshly generated DuckDB bundle resolves execution_mode

work_units.evidence: Measured 2026-08-23 over all 207 bundles: config.execution_mode and execution.execution_mode absent from every bundle; platform.config.execution_mode present on all 207; config.mode present on all 207 and agreeing; execution.mode says sql for 105 dataframe runs
work_units.summary: Re-derive the NULL counts and the key paths present in both a legacy bundle and a freshly generated one

work_units.evidence: DECISION: precedence config.execution_mode > platform.config.execution_mode > config.mode > execution.execution_mode. execution.mode EXCLUDED - it misreports 105 dataframe runs as sql. Conflict rule: first hit wins; value outside {sql,dataframe} stays None. Independent witness: filename suffix _df_/_sql_ agrees on all 200 bundles that carry one.
